decision.reason: JLCPCB gives the strongest public, repeatable component-selection surface while retaining exact-part pre-order, global sourcing and consignment paths.

platforms.reason: public assembly-parts library with visible MPN, JLC number, stock, assembly class and price; private pre-order, global-sourcing and consignment paths; Standard PCBA covers the accepted board class
turnkey, combo and consigned sourcing plus functional test and box-build options, but component availability is approval/quote driven rather than a public stock contract
turnkey PCBA, public OPL and distributor-linked sourcing, but a smaller public local library and no selected advantage over JLCPCB for this BOM

availability_tiers.name: public-stock exact
availability_tiers.rule: exact accepted MPN and JLC number are publicly in stock for Standard PCBA; stock is rechecked at every freeze and order

availability_tiers.name: approved in-stock alternate
availability_tiers.rule: only a prequalified same-function alternate inside the owning substitution class; never a factory-selected silent substitute

availability_tiers.name: private pre-order stock
availability_tiers.rule: exact MPN is bought into My Parts Lib before PCBA; public stock may supplement only where JLC rules permit

availability_tiers.name: global sourcing or consignment
availability_tiers.rule: exact identity is sourced or supplied into the private library and must be received before assembly

availability_tiers.name: factory final assembly
availability_tiers.rule: the final-assembly factory must install and test the part after PCBA; H5 and H7 cannot close until this box-build route is accepted and quoted

availability_tiers.name: factory-packed removable item
availability_tiers.rule: the factory tests compatibility where applicable and packs the removable accessory, antenna or cell separately for user installation

inside_pcba: all ordinary SMT/THT parts accepted by Standard PCBA
board connectors and soldered RF boundaries when their exact assembly rule is accepted

required_operations: five microcoax installation, strain routing and continuity test
encoder knob installation and control test
final sandwich/enclosure integration and whole-device functional test
J4-F_factory_final_assembly.close_gate: H5 and H7 cannot close until the selected factory accepts and prices these operations

required_operations: test U214 compatibility, then pack the removable Cap separately
pack protected 18650 cells separately for user installation unless compliant integrated battery shipping is qualified

policy.selection_time: prefer J0; use J1 only after owner-level equivalence checks; use J2/J3 for function-critical identities that cannot be replaced without degradation
policy.freeze_time: every soldered line must have an exact JLC number or a received private-stock route, assembly type and attrition quantity
policy.order_time: recheck stock and price; a shortage reopens sourcing, never authorizes a silent substitute
policy.continuity: permanent availability is approximated by qualified alternates or reserved private inventory, never claimed from one stock snapshot
